status_meaning.frozen: Target content is digest-pinned in freeze.json and may be used as measurable Tier 1 evidence.
status_meaning.pinned_no_truth: Repository and revision are pinned, but no independent truth exists yet. Runs against this target can produce receipts and MUST report not_measured for every quality dimension.
status_meaning.unsatisfied: The slot is specified but cannot be filled in the current single-author context. It must never be counted as evidence, present or absent.
